item.title: Home Warranty Insurance: Is It Required for Solar Installs?
item.description:
Ask ten people whether a solar install needs “warranty insurance” and you will get ten different answers, because almost nobody is talking about the same thing. Half of them mean the panel warranty. The other half mean the workmanship guarantee. Almost none of them mean the thing the question is actually about: statutory home warranty insurance, the building-industry consumer protection scheme that some jobs trigger and some do not.

I have spent twenty years around the business end of this trade, and this is one of the muddiest corners of it. So let me draw the line cleanly, because if you are quoting jobs you need to know which obligations attach to which contract, and if you are a homeowner you need to know what you are actually entitled to demand.
